status: FP32 paged-fused implementation validated; fixed queue waiting for GPUs; stratified reference run continuing until durable checkpoint 4 then automatic upgrade

validation.source: first 256 examples after shuffling pinned MATH train with the training seed
validation.selection_rule: Choose priced stratified beta maximizing validation mean(correct - reference_cost_per_loop_token * response_loop_tokens), averaging fixed depths 2/3/4 equally. Tie: lower beta. Never use MATH-500/test for this selection.
validation.note: Uniform stratified rollout fixes mean depth near 3; its mean depth cannot identify the best beta. Measure learned-policy depths after training the head.

adaptive_followups: Train learned-depth from the same base checkpoint at the validation-selected beta.
Train fixed4 at that identical beta and at the nearest other scanned beta in log space (tie: lower beta).
Compare H4 at fixed depths 2/3; compare H5 using held-out accuracy versus executed loop-tokens, including depth-head prefill.
budget_rule: When generation budget changes, preserve beta/(4*max_new_tokens).
reporting: Report paired question-level uncertainty, truncation, response length, executed compute, throughput, and checkpoint/source hashes. Engineering acceptance is not algorithm benefit.

performance_upgrade.fixed: restart from base after old numerical failure; waiting for GPUs 4,5
performance_upgrade.stratified: resume at checkpoint 4 (after five updates), with optimizer/RNG/dataset state; source run remains active until checkpoint is durable
